RESTful JSON signaling API served at `/api/voicegateway/v2/voice/`.

## Voice

| Method | Path | Description | Request | Response |
|--------|------|-------------|---------|----------|
| GET | `/api/voicegateway/v2/voice/choices` | Lists available voice choices and their supported transports. |  | `VoiceChoicesResp` |
| POST | `/api/voicegateway/v2/voice/text/ticket` | Authorizes a browser text-session upgrade with a short-lived, single-use ticket. | `VoiceTextTicketReq` | `VoiceTextTicketResp` |
| POST | `/api/voicegateway/v2/voice/rtc/offer` | Exchanges a WebRTC SDP offer for an answer, opening a voice gateway session. | `VoiceRTCOfferReq` | `VoiceRTCAnswerResp` |
| POST | `/api/voicegateway/v2/voice/rtc/{sessionID}/diagnostics` | Returns structured WebRTC connectivity diagnostics for a voice bridge session. | `VoiceRTCDiagnosticsReq` | `VoiceRTCDiagnosticsResp` |
| POST | `/api/voicegateway/v2/voice/rtc/{sessionID}` | Closes a WebRTC voice bridge session. |  | `StatusResp` |

### Voice

Voice is one selectable voice of a voice choice or synthesis model.

| Field | Type | Description | Required |
|-------|------|-------------|----------|
| `name` | `string` | Name is the SessionSetup.voice.name that selects this voice. | yes |
| `language` | `string` | Language is the ISO 639-1 code of the only language the voice speaks, such as "fr". Clients offer the voice only in sessions whose language tag has that base subtag, and session.setup rejects it in another. Empty means the voice speaks every language the model does. |  |
| `default` | `boolean` | Default marks the voice a session speaks with when SessionSetup.voice.name is empty and the session language is one the voice speaks. A list has either one default without a language or at most one default per language; clients reject a list that mixes both. A list without a default leaves the choice to the provider. |  |

### VoiceConfig

VoiceConfig describes provider-neutral voice preferences.

| Field | Type | Description | Required |
|-------|------|-------------|----------|
| `name` | `string` | Name is the requested voice name from the catalog's voices. Empty uses the voice the catalog marks default for the session language, else the configured voice, else the provider default. A voice of another language fails session setup. |  |
| `language` | `string` | Language is the requested BCP 47 language tag, such as "en-US" or "fr-CA". Empty defaults to "en-US"; an invalid tag fails session setup. A session speaks one language, and the assistant replies in it. Synthesis and recognition models that take a language receive it, recognition as a hint or forced; other models ignore it. A model that declares its languages fails session setup for another one. A model whose server rejects the language fails when its connection starts: at session setup for realtime choices, and at each utterance for recognition. | yes |

### SessionSetup

SessionSetup is the client message that initializes a voice session.

| Field | Type | Description | Required |
|-------|------|-------------|----------|
| `kind` | `MessageKind` | Kind must be "session.setup". | yes |
| `voice` | `VoiceConfig` | Voice contains the requested voice and language. | yes |
| `tools` | `ToolDeclaration[] \| null` | Tools declares the client-side tools the assistant may call. | yes |
| `context` | `Context` | Context provides initial instructions or text context for the session. | yes |
| `includeReasoning` | `boolean` | IncludeReasoning requests optional provider reasoning output for this session. It does not enable thinking or change reasoning effort. |  |
| `speech` | `SpeechConfig` | Speech selects the owner of recognition and synthesis for this session. |  |
| `recognitionModelID` | `string` | RecognitionModelID selects a recognitionModels entry for a composable LLM. Omitted uses the first available entry when input is gateway-owned. It must be omitted for client-owned recognition and indivisible choices. |  |
| `synthesisModelID` | `string` | SynthesisModelID selects a synthesisModels entry for a composable LLM. Omitted uses the first available entry when output is gateway-owned. It must be omitted for client-owned synthesis and indivisible choices. |  |
| `renegotiation` | `boolean` | Renegotiation declares that the client answers rtc.offer. The gateway then sends one after session.ready when the session takes microphone audio below 48 kHz, capping the client's Opus encoder with RFC 7587 maxplaybackrate so it stops spending uplink bits on audio the backend discards. It applies only to WebRTC sessions. |  |

### RTCOffer

RTCOffer is a gateway message that renegotiates the WebRTC media session.

The gateway sends at most one, after session.ready, and only to a client
whose session.setup set renegotiation. The client applies it as the remote
description and replies with rtc.answer; until then the session keeps its
current media parameters.

| Field | Type | Description | Required |
|-------|------|-------------|----------|
| `kind` | `MessageKind` | Kind is "rtc.offer". | yes |
| `sdp` | `string` | SDP is the gateway's SDP offer. | yes |

### RTCAnswer

RTCAnswer is a client message that answers rtc.offer.

| Field | Type | Description | Required |
|-------|------|-------------|----------|
| `kind` | `MessageKind` | Kind must be "rtc.answer". | yes |
| `sdp` | `string` | SDP is the client's SDP answer. | yes |

### SessionReady

SessionReady is a gateway message that reports the session is ready.

The gateway sends it before any turn and does not follow it with
turn.status idle: clients that capture speech start listening on
session.ready unless they request a response first.

| Field | Type | Description | Required |
|-------|------|-------------|----------|
| `kind` | `MessageKind` | Kind is "session.ready". | yes |

### SessionStatus

SessionStatus reports startup progress. Gateways repeat it at least every five
seconds while loading or waiting for capacity. Clients may refresh their
setup timeout on receipt; only session.ready enables microphone input.

| Field | Type | Description | Required |
|-------|------|-------------|----------|
| `kind` | `MessageKind` | Kind is "session.status". | yes |
| `message` | `string` | Message is a short user-visible description of startup work. | yes |

### TokenUsage

TokenUsage contains provider-reported counts. Nil means unavailable. Cached
and reasoning counts are breakdowns, never additional tokens to sum with input
and output; providers differ in how they account for reasoning output.

| Field | Type | Description | Required |
|-------|------|-------------|----------|
| `inputTokens` | `int64` | InputTokens includes the input processed again on each model request. |  |
| `outputTokens` | `int64` | OutputTokens counts generated output as reported by the provider. |  |
| `cachedTokens` | `int64` | CachedTokens is the reported cached-input breakdown. |  |
| `reasoningTokens` | `int64` | ReasoningTokens is the reported reasoning breakdown. |  |

### SessionUsage

SessionUsage is an idempotent snapshot for one gateway connection. Clients
replace snapshots with the same SessionID and carry totals across automatic
reconnects in one conversation. Missing reports are excluded from totals;
this is observed model usage, not a billing statement or ASR/TTS accounting.

| Field | Type | Description | Required |
|-------|------|-------------|----------|
| `kind` | `MessageKind` | Kind is "session.usage". | yes |
| `sessionID` | `string` | SessionID identifies the gateway connection that owns these totals. | yes |
| `provider` | `string` | Provider identifies the generation provider. | yes |
| `model` | `string` | Model identifies the generation model. | yes |
| `totals` | `TokenUsage` | Totals sums all reported responses, including tool continuations. | yes |
| `lastResponse` | `TokenUsage` | LastResponse contains the latest reported response counts, when available. |  |
| `responseID` | `string` | ResponseID identifies the response observed by this report. It is opaque and unique across gateway connections. Empty means the provider did not supply a reliable response association. |  |
| `responseUsage` | `TokenUsage` | ResponseUsage contains counts for ResponseID in this report only. Unlike LastResponse, it is never carried forward into context-only reports. |  |
| `contextTokens` | `int64` | ContextTokens is the latest reported context size, never summed. |  |
| `contextWindow` | `int64` | ContextWindow is the latest reported context capacity. |  |

### TranscriptDelta

TranscriptDelta is a gateway message that streams transcript text.
Each fragment appends to previously emitted text; it never replaces it.

| Field | Type | Description | Required |
|-------|------|-------------|----------|
| `kind` | `MessageKind` | Kind is "transcript.delta". | yes |
| `speaker` | `Speaker` | Speaker identifies who produced this transcript text. | yes |
| `text` | `string` | Text is an incremental transcript fragment. | yes |
| `responseID` | `string` | ResponseID is the opaque gateway-scoped response identity. Assistant text and its usage share this value; user text and uncorrelated providers omit it. Separate response IDs must not be merged into one transcript entry. |  |
| `draft_id` | `string` | DraftID atomically replaces the matching user draft when this text commits. |  |

### TranscriptDraft

TranscriptDraft is an ephemeral full-text user hypothesis for one microphone
utterance. Revisions replace text for ID. Empty Text clears only that ID.
Drafts never enter conversation history, activity logs, or recovery context.

| Field | Type | Description | Required |
|-------|------|-------------|----------|
| `kind` | `MessageKind` |  | yes |
| `id` | `string` |  | yes |
| `text` | `string` |  | yes |

### AssistantTextDelta

AssistantTextDelta is a gateway message that streams assistant text.
Each fragment appends to previously emitted text; it never replaces it.

| Field | Type | Description | Required |
|-------|------|-------------|----------|
| `kind` | `MessageKind` | Kind is "assistant.text.delta". | yes |
| `text` | `string` | Text is an incremental assistant text fragment. | yes |
| `responseID` | `string` | ResponseID is the opaque gateway-scoped response identity. Assistant text and its usage share this value; user text and uncorrelated providers omit it. Separate response IDs must not be merged into one transcript entry. |  |

### ReasoningDelta

ReasoningDelta is a gateway message that streams provider reasoning text.

Reasoning is not speech and not a transcript statement. A client decides
whether to display it, but must not speak it or replay it as recovery context.
The gateway includes it in the session activity log.

| Field | Type | Description | Required |
|-------|------|-------------|----------|
| `kind` | `MessageKind` | Kind is "reasoning.delta". | yes |
| `text` | `string` | Text is an incremental reasoning fragment. | yes |
| `responseID` | `string` | ResponseID is the opaque gateway-scoped response identity. Assistant text and its usage share this value; user text and uncorrelated providers omit it. Separate response IDs must not be merged into one transcript entry. |  |

### SpeechStarted

SpeechStarted is a gateway message that reports speech output started.

| Field | Type | Description | Required |
|-------|------|-------------|----------|
| `kind` | `MessageKind` | Kind is "speech.started". | yes |
| `speaker` | `Speaker` | Speaker identifies whose speech output started. | yes |

### SpeechEnded

SpeechEnded is a gateway message that reports speech output ended.

| Field | Type | Description | Required |
|-------|------|-------------|----------|
| `kind` | `MessageKind` | Kind is "speech.ended". | yes |
| `speaker` | `Speaker` | Speaker identifies whose speech output ended. | yes |

### UserSpeechStarted

UserSpeechStarted is a gateway message that reports the start of user speech
that the gateway's voice activity detection, or its realtime provider's,
detected: the start of a new user turn.

The gateway sends it in order with its other messages, before anything it
sends in reply to that speech. A user transcript.delta gives no such order:
a realtime provider transcribes user audio apart from its responses, so the
transcript of the speech that caused a tool call can arrive after the tool
call or the reply. Noise that the detection takes for speech also starts a
turn, and the gateway sends none for user.message text or for sessions in
which the client recognizes speech.

| Field | Type | Description | Required |
|-------|------|-------------|----------|
| `kind` | `MessageKind` | Kind is "user.speech.started". | yes |

### ToolCall

ToolCall is a gateway message that asks the client to execute a tool.

| Field | Type | Description | Required |
|-------|------|-------------|----------|
| `kind` | `MessageKind` | Kind is "tool.call". | yes |
| `id` | `string` | ID uniquely identifies this tool call for the matching tool.result. | yes |
| `name` | `string` | Name is the requested tool name. | yes |
| `args` | `JSONValue \| null` | Args is the JSON argument object for the requested tool. | yes |

### TurnStatus

TurnStatus is a gateway message that reports work on the current turn.

Backends that cannot observe their own progress never send it. Speech
output and tool calls take display precedence over the reported state.

| Field | Type | Description | Required |
|-------|------|-------------|----------|
| `kind` | `MessageKind` | Kind is "turn.status". | yes |
| `state` | `TurnState` | State is the gateway work in progress; idle ends the turn, including one that produced no speech. | yes |

### Interrupted

Interrupted is a gateway message that reports an interruption.

| Field | Type | Description | Required |
|-------|------|-------------|----------|
| `kind` | `MessageKind` | Kind is "interrupted". | yes |
| `source` | `InterruptSource` | Source identifies what interrupted the turn. | yes |
| `message` | `string` | Message optionally provides more detail about the interruption. |  |

### Error

Error is a gateway message that reports an error.

| Field | Type | Description | Required |
|-------|------|-------------|----------|
| `kind` | `MessageKind` | Kind is "error". | yes |
| `message` | `string` | Message is a human-readable error description. | yes |
| `recoverable` | `boolean` | Recoverable reports whether the client may continue using the session. | yes |
